visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit underground parking garage, a woman with long dark hair, wearing a maroon cap, a white tube top, and pink trousers, stands with her back to the camera. She holds a camera up to her eye, looking toward a row of yellow taxis parked in the background. Bright industrial overhead lights illuminate the concrete floor and metallic pipes. (2) The scene shifts to the exterior of a street-side restaurant with a prominent yellow sign featuring red characters for 'Shanghai Shengjian Tangbao.' The woman walks along a busy urban street with parked scooters and pedestrians. She enters a simple indoor dining area with wooden tables and white tiled walls. (3) On a white plate, six small, round pan-fried buns topped with black sesame seeds are displayed. A pair of chopsticks lifts a bun to show its crispy, browned bottom. The woman sits at a table, bringing a bun to her mouth; she reacts with a wide-eyed, surprised expression as steam presumably rises from the food. (4) The woman walks through a narrow outdoor alleyway lined with parked scooters and hanging decorations. She enters a series of retail shops: first, a modern cafe with jute coffee sacks on a brick wall; second, a milk tea shop with a large cup-shaped sign; and third, a shop featuring a floor-to-ceiling shelf of bear-shaped plastic bottles. (5) Inside a cozy, retro-style restaurant, the woman sits at a table. A bowl of noodles topped with a dark century egg and thick brown sauce is shown in a close-up. She uses chopsticks to vigorously mix the ingredients. The background is filled with eclectic posters and warm, dim lighting. (6) A digital graphic appears on screen, featuring cartoon bear illustrations, text about a '2025 Kaohsiung Milk Tea Festival,' and dates '9.20~21.' The woman is shown again in a fast-paced montage, drinking from various cups and smiling broadly at different locations.
